Choose 'Fixed rate' mode, sales 500,000 CNY, rate 5%.
Commission = 500,000 × 5% = 25,000 CNY. Pre-tax income = base + 25,000; if base is 0, pre-tax is 25,000, and personal tax is estimated as 'taxable income = 25,000 - 5,000 = 20,000'.
